properties.description: Cut 2026-10-13 on Anthony's word ("Merge 738 and 152", then "Cut v0.83.5 and move flo2.io to it"). A patch with one part, #738. search_design and topic_report now read every field a node's prose is written in: 15 fields were added, a change's rationale among them. A new test lists every text property as either searched or left out with its reason. The full-text index records which fields it was built over, so a design opened by this release rebuilds its index once, by itself. That includes the one-shot --call door, which used to leave older nodes unsearchable until they were next written. The search_design description names the prose fields. No tool or argument was added or removed, and no node or edge type moved. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: v0.83.5 — search reads every prose field, and an index built over fewer fields rebuilds itself
